summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Toyota Motor Corporation, a foreign private issuer, on May 8, 2026. The filing contains English translations of documents filed with the Tokyo Stock Exchange, including FY2026 financial results, a notice of the ordinary general shareholders meeting, and a notice concerning disposition of treasury stock under a restricted stock compensation plan. The regulatory filing is a routine periodic report of financial information and corporate housekeeping items; there is no mention of any merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or other special situation. The filing is purely a financial results announcement and meeting notice.
